finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: User input is directly sent to the server without validation
finding.assumptions: The server might execute the received data as a command

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for a path from the untrusted source to the dangerous operation that is not neutralized by checks already present in the code. The input from scanf is an integer and is directly sent to the server using sendto. There is no indication of any command execution on the server side. The code does not show any command execution or shell invocation.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: User input is directly read into an integer without validation
finding.assumptions: The input might be larger than the expected integer size

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the size of the input before sending it. The input is read into an integer using scanf, which inherently limits the input size to the size of an integer. Additionally, the size of the data being sent is explicitly specified as sizeof(int) in the sendto function.
